headline: England Survive Norway Scare in 2-1 Extra-Time Thriller
whyCareReason: Haaland and Odegaard vs the Three Lions: a quarter-final packed with Premier League storylines that needed extra time.
teaser: England trailed, regrouped, and finished 2-1 winners after extra time against a fearless Norway side.
story:
Norway started like a side with nothing to lose. Early pressure and a clinical finish put England behind and silenced large parts of the stadium. England's response was pure tournament football: tighter midfield distances, quicker wide switches, and growing territory.

Regulation finished level on the night's drama before England found the winner in extra time. Norway still threatened through Haaland's runs in behind, forcing England's back line into last-ditch recovery sprints. The Three Lions managed the final minutes with game-smart fouls and composure in possession.

England advance 2-1 after extra time. Norway leave with a tournament that reintroduced them as a genuine knockout force.
stakes: Quarter-final football leaves no safety net. England move on; Norway's revival ends one step short of the semis.
rivalryAngle: So many club teammates on opposite sides made this feel like a Premier League derby with a World Cup prize.
funFacts: Norway are affectionately known as the Løvene.
England are affectionately known as the Three Lions.
This high-profile match was held at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami on 2026-07-11.
